name: Build Test Docker Images

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      branch:
        description: 'Branch to build from (default: current branch)'
        required: false
        type: string
      sha:
        description: 'Commit SHA to build from (default: current commit)'
        required: false
        type: string

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  build-test-images:
    name: Build Test Docker Images
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Free Disk Space (Ubuntu)
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          tool-cache: false
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: false
          docker-images: true
          swap-storage: true

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.branch || github.ref_name }}

      - name: Get commit SHA
        id: get_sha
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.sha }}" ]; then
            SHA_VALUE="${{ inputs.sha }}"
          else
            SHA_VALUE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          fi
          echo "sha=$SHA_VALUE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Get short SHA
        id: get_short_sha
        run: |
          SHORT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          echo "short_sha=$SHORT_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Get branch name
        id: get_branch
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.branch }}" ]; then
            BRANCH_NAME="${{ inputs.branch }}"
          else
            BRANCH_NAME=$(echo "${{ github.ref }}" | sed 's|refs/heads/||')
          fi
          echo "branch=$BRANCH_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push log image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./log/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/log:${{ steps.get_branch.outputs.branch }}-${{ steps.get_short_sha.outputs.short_sha }}
          build-args: |
            GIT_COMMIT=${{ steps.get_sha.outputs.sha }}
            GIT_BRANCH=${{ steps.get_branch.outputs.branch }}

      - name: Build and push timeseries image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./timeseries/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/timeseries:${{ steps.get_branch.outputs.branch }}-${{ steps.get_short_sha.outputs.short_sha }}
          build-args: |
            GIT_COMMIT=${{ steps.get_sha.outputs.sha }}
            GIT_BRANCH=${{ steps.get_branch.outputs.branch }}

      - name: Build and push vector image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./vector/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/vector:${{ steps.get_branch.outputs.branch }}-${{ steps.get_short_sha.outputs.short_sha }}
          build-args: |
            GIT_COMMIT=${{ steps.get_sha.outputs.sha }}
            GIT_BRANCH=${{ steps.get_branch.outputs.branch }}
